name: Kanto in Motion
description: Kanto in Motion multi-generation HD Pokemon presentation and battle overhaul. Supports Red/Blue/Yellow, Gold/Silver/Crystal, and FireRed/LeafGreen/Ruby/Sapphire/Emerald; v1.7.1 expands Gen 2 Modern UI presentation with PC/storage and evolution screens, upgrades the Gen 2 Party, Pokedex and Trainer Card, improves Gen 2 HD icon reliability, and adds cross-generation Modern evolution presentation for Gen 2 and Gen 3.
